title: Stone's bottom velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the rock's speed at the base of the slope using kinematics (e.g., v = sqrt(2*a*x)).

title: Stone's slope time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the rock to roll down the 16m slope.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Correctly sets up the kinematic equations for the rock and truck after the rock reaches the base, accounting for the driver's 1-second reaction delay.

title: Collision time or distance
description: Important: Correctly solves for either the collision time (if no escape) or the minimum separation distance (if escape occurs), selecting the physically valid root.

title: Constant speed phase check
description: Optional: Explicitly notes or verifies that the rock's constant speed phase after the slope has zero duration before deceleration begins.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses the rock's deceleration (1.5 m/s²) with an incorrect sign in kinematic equations.

title: Reaction time omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the 1-second driver reaction time when determining the truck's start time relative to the rock's motion.

title: Invalid time root selection
description: Pitfall: Selects the larger, non-physical time root from the quadratic equation for the collision/meeting event.
